name: PB15 R14 - LOLBin tai file thuc thi (certutil/bitsadmin/IWR)
description: Sysmon 1: certutil -urlcache, bitsadmin /transfer, Invoke-WebRequest/curl -OutFile toi file thuc thi. T1105.
query: event.code:1 and ((process.name:certutil.exe and process.command_line:(*urlcache* or *URLCache* or *-split* or *verifyctl*)) or (process.name:bitsadmin.exe and process.command_line:(*transfer* or *TRANSFER* or *addfile*)) or (process.name:(powershell.exe or pwsh.exe) and process.command_line:(*Invoke-WebRequest* or *invoke-webrequest* or *iwr?* or *wget?* or *curl?* or *Start-BitsTransfer*) and process.command_line:(*-OutFile* or *-outfile* or *-o?* or *-Destination*))) and process.command_line:(*.exe* or *.dll* or *.ps1* or *.bat* or *.hta* or *.vbs* or *.scr*)
